messages:
emily: quick check on the prompt-sets approval flow — i noticed the bulk-approve keyboard shortcut (Shift+A) fires even when a text input in the eval run panel is focused. People hit it by accident and approve tests while typing.

jose: oof. that’s bad. expected behavior: shortcut disabled when any editable field has focus. Are we checking document.activeElement?

emily: currently we only check if a modal is open, not field focus. fix would be to gate shortcuts with a utility: isEditable(element) that checks contenteditable, input, textarea, role=textbox.

rachel: +1. also microcopy: when bulk-approving multiple prompt sets, the confirmation modal says "Approve X prompt sets" — users in audit/compliance asked to show which runs contain failing tests. Suggest body: "This will approve X prompt sets (Y contain failures). Approving failing sets requires justification."

emily: good call. we should surface counts for passing vs failing and disable the single-step approve if Y>0. Offer "Approve passing only (M)" and "Force approve all (X)" flows.

tom: for force-approve flow, design suggests a required justification and a 30-char minimum. legal wants it persisted to the audit event and included in exported csv. let's make sure backend accepts a `justification` field on the bulk action.

jose: backend note: we already store audit events per run. bulk op can create a parent audit record with metadata: actor, justification, counts, and child pointers. we'll add justification string; keep max length 2000 chars.

designbot: Accessibility check: confirmation modal missing aria-describedby for the count breakdown. Also recommend focus trap and return focus to the triggering button. Contrast: confirm primary (blue-600) is 4.1:1 over white 1 passes for larger text but ensure label size >= 14px.

emily: thanks bot. another tiny microcopy ask: toast after action currently reads "Approved X" — change to "Approved X prompt sets — undo" with an accessible label that includes the audit id. e.g., "Approved 12 prompt sets (audit id: a123)."

rachel: +1 for audit id. In the toast, include a keyboard-accessible Undo button. If someone hits Undo, we should open a modal confirming revert and show the affected runs count.

jose: implementable. undo will call the audit parent and revert child statuses if within 5 minutes window. we'll add a feature flag first.

tom: design nit: when rendering the list of affected runs in the revert modal, keep rows condensed and ensure readable even at mobile width. For mobile, show a summary line with a chevron to expand details.

emily: perfect. i'll update figma with: disabled shortcut when inputs focused, new confirmation copy (counts + failing count), force-approve justification textarea with min 30 chars, toast with audit id + undo, and keyboard flow notes. please review by EOD if you have copy nits. :memo:
